reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 a SOURCE clause's identifier-1 may name an item of any Data Division section (file, working-storage, linkage), and when it names a Report Section item it must be PAGE-COUNTER, LINE-COUNTER or a sum counter of the report whose description holds the SOURCE clause; any other report-section name (report group, group entry, printable item, another report's sum counter) is refused.
reader.edition-search: Read the SOURCE arm of ResolveReports (the FieldReferenceSource case calling ReportSectionNameIn with the current ReportModel), ReportSectionNameIn, IsReportSectionOnlyName, ReportSectionOnlyNames and CounterResolver.SumCounterFamilyFor; grep of ReportSectionBinder.cs for Edition.DialectLevel / Edition.Edition / SubscriptedClauseOperands / CobolVersion finds edition arms only in other clauses (CONTROL shape, SUM placement, column, PRESENT WHEN, SumCounterOperand85 for non-report clauses), none on the SOURCE section screen or the counter lookup.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the screen and the current-report sum counter lookup are one path at every edition; later editions add an arithmetic-expression operand form, which 1985 lacks (a separate rule).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses exercise a subscripted/ref-modified WS operand, an own sum counter and the WS/report homonym; they do not exercise PAGE-COUNTER, LINE-COUNTER, a file or linkage section operand, or the refusal of a printable item, group entry, report group or another report's sum counter at 1985.

reader.notes: Conforms on every probed form. Two cosmetic diagnostic issues, not verdict-bearing: COBOL2144 at --std 85 cites §2023:13.18.53.3 SR4 rather than the 1985 rule, and a qualified operand is rendered without spaces ('TOT2OFR2') because the message uses DataReferenceContext.GetText().

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-226/: s1fn.cob (SOURCE FUNCTION UPPER-CASE(WS-X) and its ref-modified form, an alphanumeric function-identifier, which §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR3 admits wherever an identifier is) EXIT 0, report 'ABC BC'; s4cd.cob (SOURCE of two COMMUNICATION SECTION CD fields, 'any section of the Data Division') EXIT 0, report 'QUEUE1       000042'; s2expr.cob (SOURCE WS-AMT + 1, the 2002 arithmetic-expression form) refused COBOL0900 'requires COBOL-2002'; s3intfn.cob (SOURCE FUNCTION INTEGER(...), refused at 85 by §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4) refused COBOL0900; s5rname.cob (SOURCE R1, a report-name) refused COBOL1639. Together with the reader's printable/group/report-group/other-report sum counter refusals and PAGE-COUNTER/LINE-COUNTER/own sum counter/file/linkage admissions, every operand class of SR1 behaves as the 1985 text says. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.18.3 SR1  (3.18.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR3 ... the text is in SR3'; 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4 ... the text is in SR4'.
